prompt: The new security system proved to be an effective ______ against potential intruders.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Deterrent' (caydırıcı) kelimesi, potansiyel davetsiz misafirlere karşı güvenlik sisteminin etkisini en iyi anlatan kelimedir. 'Incentive' (teşvik) tam zıttı bir etki yaratır.

prompt: Due to the economic instability, there has been a significant ______ in the currency exchange rates over the last few months.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Ekonomik istikrarsızlık döviz kurlarında 'fluctuation' (dalgalanma) yaratır. Diğer şıklar durağanlık veya uyum bildirir.

prompt: Heavy snowfall and icy roads ______ the rescue team's efforts to reach the stranded climbers.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kötü hava koşulları kurtarma çabalarını 'hindered' (engelledi/aksattı). Diğer şıklar (kolaylaştırdı, geliştirdi) olumludur.

prompt: The discovery of penicillin ______ changed the field of medicine, saving millions of lives.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Milyonlarca hayatı kurtaran bir keşif, tıp alanını 'profoundly' (derinden/kökten) değiştirmiştir. 'Marginally' (azıcık) yetersiz kalır.

prompt: All employees are expected to ______ the company's code of conduct to maintain a professional environment.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kurallara veya yönetmeliklere 'comply with' (uymak/itaat etmek) gerekir.

prompt: Scientists have achieved a major ______ in cancer research, identifying a new method to target tumor cells.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bilimsel araştırmalarda büyük gelişme veya buluşa 'breakthrough' denir. 'Breakdown' çöküş/arıza demektir.

prompt: By the time the guests arrived, we ______ all the preparations for the party.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the time' + Past Simple (arrived) yapısı, ana cümlede 'Past Perfect' (had finished) gerektirir.

prompt: The car was completely damaged in the accident; the driver ______ driving very fast.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Geçmişe dönük güçlü bir çıkarım (araba mahvolduğuna göre hızlı gidiyor olmalı) için 'must have been V-ing' kullanılır.

prompt: If he ______ the map more carefully, he ______ lost now.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Mixed Conditional. Geçmişteki bir eylem (haritaya bakmamak - Type 3) şimdiki bir sonuca (kaybolmak - Type 2) yol açmıştır. 'Had checked / wouldn't be' yapısı doğrudur.

prompt: The new bridge, ______ construction was delayed for two years, will finally open next week.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Köprünün inşası' anlamında iyelik bildiren 'whose construction' yapısı kullanılır.

prompt: Many people believe that ______ regular exercise is the key to a healthy life.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Cümlenin öznesi konumundaki eylem 'Gerund' (V-ing) olmalıdır. 'Taking regular exercise' (Düzenli egzersiz yapmak).

prompt: The documents ______ by the secretary need to be signed by the manager.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The documents (which were) prepared' kısaltmasıdır. Edilgen anlam taşıdığı için V3 (prepared) kullanılır.

prompt: ______ she was very tired, she completed the report before the deadline.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'She was very tired' tam bir cümledir ve zıtlık bildirir. Bu yüzden 'Although' (rağmen) kullanılır. 'Despite' isim öbeği alır.

prompt: I have little money left, so I can buy ______ bread nor milk.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Nor' bağlacı 'neither' ile kullanılır (neither ... nor - ne o ne de öbürü).

prompt: It is widely believed ______ the invention of the internet has changed the world more than any other event.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is believed that...' (İnanılıyor ki...) kalıbı standart bir Noun Clause yapısıdır.

prompt: The train arrived at the station ______ 5 o'clock in the afternoon.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Saatlerle birlikte 'at' edatı kullanılır (at 5 o'clock).

prompt: Artificial Intelligence is increasingly being used in the field of medicine. Specifically, it helps doctors (17) ______ diseases more accurately.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Help someone (to) do something' kalıbı gereği fiil yalın (diagnose) veya 'to diagnose' olabilir. Şıklarda yalın hal mevcuttur.

prompt: By analyzing vast amounts of data, AI algorithms can identify patterns that are (18) ______ to the human eye.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: AI'ın insan gözünün göremediği kalıpları bulması anlatılıyor, bu yüzden 'invisible' (görünmez) doğrudur.

prompt: This technology is particularly useful in radiology, (19) ______ it aids in detecting tumors in X-rays.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Radyoloji bir alan/saha olduğu için soyut yer bildiren 'where' (ki orada/bu alanda) kullanımı uygundur.

prompt: (20) ______ its potential benefits, the integration of AI into healthcare raises ethical concerns.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Faydalarına 'rağmen' endişe yaratıyor. Zıtlık bildiren ve isim öbeği alan 'Despite' doğrudur.

prompt: One major concern is the privacy of patient data, (21) ______ must be protected at all costs.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Patient data' (hasta verisi) cansız bir varlık olduğu için ve virgülden sonra geldiği için 'which' kullanılır.

prompt: Moreover, there is the risk that AI systems might make errors (22) ______ biased algorithms.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Hataların sebebi 'taraflı algoritmalar'dır. Sebep bildiren 'due to' (yüzünden/nedeniyle) uygundur.

prompt: Therefore, human oversight remains (23) ______ to ensure patient safety.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Hasta güvenliği için insan gözetimi 'crucial' (çok önemli/hayati) olmaya devam etmektedir.

prompt: Doctors and AI should work together rather than one (24) ______ the other.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rather than' edatından sonra fiilimsi 'replacing' (yerine geçmesi) kullanımı yaygındır.

prompt: Ultimately, the goal is to enhance medical care (25) ______ improving accuracy and efficiency.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By improving' (geliştirerek) yöntemi ifade eder.

prompt: As technology advances, we can expect AI to play an even (26) ______ role in future treatments.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Teknoloji ilerledikçe rolün 'daha büyük' (greater) olması beklenir.

prompt: Even if you have the best qualifications for the job, ______.
A: you are guaranteed to be hired
B: you may still not get the position due to lack of experience
C: employers will always offer you a high salary
D: interview skills are not important at all
E: it is easy to find employment in this sector
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Even if' (olsa bile) beklentinin aksini ifade eder. Nitelikli olsan bile 'işi alamayabilirsin' (may not get).

prompt: The lecture was cancelled at the last minute ______.
A: because the professor fell ill suddenly
B: so that students could attend it
D: since everyone was present in the hall
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İptal edilme sebebi aranmalıdır. 'Profesör aniden hastalandığı için' (because...) mantıklıdır.

prompt: In order to reduce traffic congestion in the city center, ______.
A: more parking lots should be built
B: people should be encouraged to use public transport
C: car prices must be lowered significantly
E: bicycles are banned from the streets
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Trafiği azaltmak için 'toplu taşıma teşvik edilmelidir' (encouraged to use public transport).

prompt: Unless the government introduces stricter regulations, ______.
A: pollution levels will continue to rise
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Unless' (-mezse) olumsuz koşul. Kurallar gelmezse 'kirlilik artmaya devam eder' (continue to rise).

prompt: He spoke so quietly that ______.
A: everyone in the room could hear him clearly
C: nobody at the back could understand what he said
D: he was shouting at the audience
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'So ... that' (o kadar sessizdi ki). Sonuç: Arkadakiler anlayamadı.

prompt: The more you practice speaking a foreign language, ______.
B: the more fluent you will become
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' kalıbı. Ne kadar pratik yaparsan, o kadar akıcı olursun.

prompt: Since the bridge is under construction, ______.
A: drivers have to use a different route
B: the traffic flow is smoother than ever
C: it was completed two years ago
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Köprü inşaat halinde olduğu için (Since...) sürücüler başka yol kullanmalı.

prompt: Whatever happens during the meeting, ______.
A: we must remain calm and professional
B: the decision has already been made
D: it was a very productive discussion
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Ne olursa olsun' (Whatever happens), 'sakin kalmalıyız' (must remain calm).

prompt: While electronic books are convenient, ______.
A: they are heavier than paper books
B: many readers still prefer the feel of a physical book
C: libraries are refusing to lend them
D: digital screens are good for eyes
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'While' zıtlık bildirir. E-kitap pratik olsa da, okuyucular fiziksel kitabı tercih ediyor.

prompt: Not only did he arrive late to the interview, ______.
A: and he also forgot his resume
B: but he also forgot to bring his resume
C: so he got the job immediately
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not only ... but also' kalıbı. Sadece geç kalmadı, aynı zamanda CV'sini unuttu.

prompt: The discovery of fire is considered one of the most important turning points in human history.
A: Ateşin keşfi, insanlık tarihinin en önemli dönüm noktalarından biri olarak kabul edilir.
B: İnsanlık tarihi, ateşin keşfiyle önemli bir dönüm noktasına girmiştir.
C: Ateşin bulunması, insanlık tarihinde önemli bir olay olarak görülmektedir.
D: En önemli dönüm noktası olan ateş, insanlık tarihini değiştirmiştir.
E: İnsanlık tarihinin dönüm noktalarından biri de ateşin keşfedilmesidir.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'is considered' (kabul edilir), 'one of the most important turning points' (en önemli dönüm noktalarından biri).

prompt: Global warming is likely to cause more frequent and severe weather events in the future.
A: Küresel ısınma gelecekte muhtemelen daha sık ve şiddetli hava olaylarına neden olacaktır.
B: Gelecekteki şiddetli hava olaylarının sebebi küresel ısınma olabilir.
C: Küresel ısınma yüzünden gelecekte hava olayları sıklaşacaktır.
D: Daha sık ve şiddetli hava olayları gelecekte küresel ısınmayı artıracaktır.
E: Küresel ısınmanın gelecekte hava olaylarını değiştirmesi bekleniyor.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'is likely to cause' (neden olması muhtemeldir/olacaktır), 'more frequent and severe' (daha sık ve şiddetli).

prompt: Unless we reduce our plastic consumption, our oceans will be filled with waste.
A: Plastik tüketimimizi azaltmazsak okyanuslarımız atıklarla dolacak.
B: Okyanusların atıkla dolmaması için plastik tüketimini azaltmalıyız.
C: Plastik tüketimi azalınca okyanuslar atıklardan temizlenecek.
D: Eğer plastik kullanmayı bırakırsak okyanusları kurtarabiliriz.
E: Atıklarla dolan okyanuslar plastik tüketiminin sonucudur.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Unless' (-mezsek), 'will be filled' (dolacak).

prompt: Başarılı olmak için sadece yetenekli olmak yetmez, aynı zamanda çok çalışmak gerekir.
A: To be successful, being talented is not enough; one must also work hard.
B: Working hard is more important than being talented for success.
C: If you are talented, you don't need to work hard to succeed.
D: Success requires talent rather than hard work.
E: Being talented and working hard are both necessary for success.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'is not enough' (yetmez), 'must also work hard' (aynı zamanda çok çalışmak gerekir).

prompt: Gelişmekte olan ülkeler, eğitim ve sağlık hizmetlerine daha fazla yatırım yapmalıdır.
A: Developing countries should invest more in education and healthcare services.
B: Education and healthcare are important for developing countries.
C: Investments in health and education are increasing in developing countries.
D: Developing countries have invested enough in healthcare.
E: More investment is needed for developing countries' education systems.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Developing countries' (gelişmekte olan ülkeler), 'should invest more' (daha fazla yatırım yapmalıdır).

prompt: Toplantının amacı, projenin karşılaştığı temel zorlukları tartışmaktır.
A: The purpose of the meeting is to discuss the main challenges the project faces.
B: We met to discuss the problems of the project.
C: The meeting was held to solve the project's challenges.
D: The main challenges of the project were discussed in the meeting.
E: Discussing the project's challenges is the goal of us.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The purpose of the meeting' (toplantının amacı), 'is to discuss' (tartışmaktır).

prompt: (Passage: Climate Change Impacts) According to the passage, rising global temperatures are leading to ______.
A: an increase in agricultural productivity everywhere
B: more stable weather patterns across the globe
C: melting polar ice caps and rising sea levels
D: a decrease in the frequency of hurricanes
E: better living conditions for polar bears
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Küresel ısınma buzulların erimesine (melting ice caps) ve deniz seviyesinin yükselmesine yol açar.

prompt: (Passage: Climate Change Impacts) The passage implies that coastal cities ______.
A: are safe from the effects of climate change
B: will benefit from rising sea levels
C: are at risk of flooding in the future
E: have no role in carbon emissions
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Deniz seviyesi yükseldiği için kıyı şehirleri sel riski (risk of flooding) altındadır.

prompt: (Passage: Climate Change Impacts) Extreme weather events, such as droughts and storms, serve as evidence of ______.
B: the stability of the climate system
C: the accelerating pace of climate change
E: natural cycles unrelated to human activity
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Aşırı hava olayları, iklim değişikliğinin hızlandığının (accelerating pace) kanıtıdır.

prompt: (Passage: Climate Change Impacts) The author suggests that mitigating climate change requires ______.
A: global cooperation and reducing greenhouse gases
E: waiting for the climate to fix itself
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İklim değişikliğini azaltmak küresel işbirliği ve gaz salınımını azaltmayı gerektirir.

prompt: (Passage: History of Printing) The invention of the printing press by Gutenberg in the 15th century ______.
A: had little impact on society at the time
B: made books more expensive and rare
C: allowed for the mass production of books
D: was immediately banned by all governments
E: decreased the literacy rate in Europe
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Matbaa, kitapların seri üretimini (mass production) sağlamıştır.

prompt: (Passage: History of Printing) Before the printing press, books were ______.
A: copied by hand and very costly
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Matbaadan önce kitaplar el yazmasıydı (copied by hand) ve pahalıydı.

prompt: (Passage: History of Printing) The spread of knowledge facilitated by the printing press contributed to ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bilginin yayılması Rönesans ve Reform hareketlerine katkıda bulunmuştur.

prompt: (Passage: History of Printing) Today, the printing industry is facing challenges from ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Günümüzde matbaacılık dijital medya ve e-kitapların rekabetiyle karşı karşıyadır.

prompt: (Passage: Antibiotic Resistance) Antibiotic resistance occurs when ______.
A: bacteria evolve to survive drug treatments
B: patients stop taking medicine too early
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Direnç, bakterilerin ilaçlara karşı hayatta kalmak için evrimleşmesiyle (evolve) oluşur.

prompt: (Passage: Antibiotic Resistance) Overuse and misuse of antibiotics are cited as ______.
C: primary drivers of the resistance crisis
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Gereksiz kullanım krizin ana nedenlerindendir (primary drivers).

prompt: (Passage: Antibiotic Resistance) If resistance continues to grow, common infections could ______.
C: be cured with simple herbal teas
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Direnç artarsa basit enfeksiyonlar bile ölümcül (deadly) olabilir.

prompt: (Passage: Antibiotic Resistance) To combat this threat, the medical community suggests ______.
A: using stronger antibiotics for every cold
B: developing new drugs and using existing ones responsibly
D: ignoring the problem until it goes away
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Yeni ilaçlar geliştirmek ve mevcutları sorumlu kullanmak (responsibly) önerilir.

prompt: (Passage: Psychology of Memory) Short-term memory is described as ______.
B: having a limited capacity and duration
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kısa süreli bellek sınırlı kapasite ve süreye (limited capacity) sahiptir.

prompt: (Passage: Psychology of Memory) Information is transferred to long-term memory through ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Uzun süreli belleğe geçiş tekrar (rehearsal) ve anlamlandırma ile olur.

prompt: (Passage: Psychology of Memory) The passage suggests that memory is not like a video recording because ______.
B: it is reconstructive and can be altered
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bellek yeniden kurgulanabilir (reconstructive) ve değişebilir.

prompt: (Passage: Psychology of Memory) Factors that can affect memory retrieval include ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Stres ve duygusal durum hatırlamayı (retrieval) etkiler.

prompt: (Passage: Electric Vehicles) Electric vehicles (EVs) are gaining popularity because ______.
C: they are slower than gas cars
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: EV'lerin popülerliği sıfır emisyon (zero emissions) üretmelerindendir.

prompt: (Passage: Electric Vehicles) One of the main challenges for EV adoption is ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Şarj altyapısı eksikliği (lack of infrastructure) temel sorundur.

prompt: (Passage: Electric Vehicles) Battery technology is improving to address issues of ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Pil teknolojisi menzil kaygısı (range anxiety) ve şarj süresini iyileştiriyor.

prompt: (Passage: Electric Vehicles) The future of transportation is expected to be ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Gelecekte ulaşımın elektrikli ve otonom olması bekleniyor.

prompt:
Doctor: How long have you had this cough?
Patient: For about two weeks now.
Doctor: ______
Patient: No, it's a dry cough mostly.
B: Does it hurt when you walk?
C: Are you coughing up any phlegm or blood?
D: Why did you wait so long?
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Hasta 'kuru öksürük' dediğine göre doktor balgam veya kan olup olmadığını sormuştur.

prompt:
Manager: We need to cut costs for the next quarter.
Employee: Do you have any specific areas in mind?
Manager: ______
Employee: That might be difficult since we need to promote the new product.
A: I think we should hire more people.
B: We could reduce the marketing budget.
D: We need to buy new computers.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Çalışan 'yeni ürünü tanıtmamız lazım' diyerek itiraz ettiğine göre, yönetici 'pazarlama bütçesini kısma' önerisi yapmıştır.

prompt:
Sarah: Did you watch the movie I recommended?
Mike: Yes, but I didn't really like the ending.
Sarah: ______
Mike: It just felt too abrupt and unresolved.
B: I knew you would love it!
C: Who did you watch it with?
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Mike sonunu beğenmediğini söylüyor, Sarah sebebini (What was wrong) soruyor.

prompt:
Student: I'm worried I won't finish my assignment on time.
Teacher: ______
Student: That would be a huge relief, thank you.
B: I can give you a two-day extension.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Öğrenci rahatladığına (huge relief) göre öğretmen ek süre (extension) vermiştir.

prompt:
Tourist: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the museum?
Local: ______
Tourist: Thank you very much.
B: Go straight and turn left at the lights.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Turist teşekkür ettiğine göre yerli kişi yolu tarif etmiştir.

prompt: Hardly anyone believed that the project would succeed.
A: Almost everyone thought the project would fail.
B: Everyone was confident in the project's success.
E: Some people believed in the project strongly.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Hardly anyone believed' (neredeyse kimse inanmadı) = 'Almost everyone thought it would fail' (neredeyse herkes başarısız olacağını düşündü).

prompt: If it hadn't been for his help, we couldn't have finished the job.
A: We finished the job without his help.
B: His help was unnecessary for us.
C: We were able to finish the job thanks to his help.
D: He didn't help us, so we couldn't finish.
E: We helped him finish the job.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'If it hadn't been for his help' (Yardımı olmasaydı...) = 'Thanks to his help' (Yardımı sayesinde başardık).

prompt: Whatever happens, I will always support you.
A: I will support you only if good things happen.
B: No matter what the circumstances are, you have my support.
C: I might support you depending on the situation.
D: Don't expect my support if things go wrong.
E: I will support you when I have time.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Whatever happens' = 'No matter what'.

prompt: Much as I admire his work, I don't agree with his political views.
A: I admire his work and his politics.
B: I don't like his work or his views.
C: Although I respect his work, I dislike his politics.
D: His political views are the reason I admire him.
E: I agree with him because his work is good.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Much as' (Her ne kadar ... olsa da) zıtlık bildirir. İşini seviyorum ama (although) görüşlerine katılmıyorum.

prompt: Space exploration has always fascinated humanity. From the first moon landing to the Mars rovers, we have pushed the boundaries. ______ However, the cost of these missions is astronomical.
A: Aliens have been found on Mars.
B: Private companies are now entering the space race.
C: The moon is made of cheese.
E: We have learned a lot about our universe.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Uzay keşfi anlatılıyor. Araya özel şirketlerin girdiği (güncel gelişme) ve sonra maliyet sorununa geçildiği akış uygundur.

prompt: Good nutrition is essential for a healthy life. Eating a balanced diet provides the necessary vitamins. ______ In addition, staying hydrated is crucial.
B: Exercise is also bad for you.
C: It also boosts the immune system.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Beslenmenin faydaları sıralanıyor. 'Bağışıklığı güçlendirir' cümlesi akışı tamamlar.

prompt: Remote work has become very popular. Employees enjoy the flexibility it offers. ______ On the other hand, some people feel isolated working from home.
B: They also save money on commuting.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Uzaktan çalışmanın olumlu yönleri sıralanıyor (esneklik -> yol parasından tasarruf), sonra olumsuza geçiliyor.

prompt: Ancient civilizations built impressive structures. The Pyramids of Egypt are a prime example. ______ These monuments show the advanced engineering skills of the past.
A: They used modern cranes to build them.
C: They were constructed as tombs for pharaohs.
D: The weather in Egypt is hot.
E: Food was scarce in ancient times.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Piramitlerden bahsediliyor. Onların 'firavun mezarı' olarak yapıldığı bilgisi bağlamla uyumludur.

prompt: (I) Dolphins are highly intelligent marine mammals. (II) They use echolocation to find food. (III) Sharks are dangerous predators that hunt in the ocean. (IV) Dolphins also have a complex social structure. (V) They are known to help humans in distress.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Paragraf yunuslarla (dolphins) ilgili. III. cümle köpekbalıklarından (sharks) bahsederek akışı bozuyor.

prompt: (I) Coffee production supports millions of farmers worldwide. (II) The beans are harvested and then roasted. (III) Tea is another popular beverage in Asia. (IV) Brazil is the largest producer of coffee. (V) The demand for specialty coffee is growing.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Konu kahve üretimi. III. cümle çaydan bahsediyor.

prompt: (I) Marie Curie was a pioneering physicist and chemist. (II) She conducted groundbreaking research on radioactivity. (III) Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity. (IV) She was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize. (V) Her work paved the way for modern medical treatments.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metin Marie Curie hakkında. III. cümle Einstein'dan bahsediyor.

prompt: (I) The internet has revolutionized how we access information. (II) It allows for instant communication across the globe. (III) Television was invented in the early 20th century. (IV) Online education has become accessible to many. (V) E-commerce has changed the way we shop.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Konu internetin etkileri. III. cümle televizyonun icadıyla ilgili.
